text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Furioso!
Why, why!? What are you doing in Funabashi?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I had some business back home.
I'm on my way back to Tokyo now.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I see~! ...Hey, what about dinner?
Why don't you come eat at my place like old times?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I have to work hard on my races right now too.
So I'd love to hear stories about how you're doing over there.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
! Of course. Hearing that,
there's no way I couldn't lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's a deal~! Yay~!
Ehehe, I'm so glad I bumped into you.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As a friend, and as a competitor.
I am more than happy to listen anytime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso prioritized spending time with her friends
and ended up slacking off on training.
